h1: Cha Am My House — a pool resort near Cha-Am Beach that gets you a swimming pool and a lift on a light budget
intro: If you want to do Cha-Am with a "pool to dip into" and a beach you can walk to, but without paying full beachfront-resort prices, Cha Am My House is a name budget travellers in Cha-Am bring up often · it's a 2-star resort of around 43 rooms in the Cha-Am beach area, on the Soi Sathani Khonong side of Ruamchit Road, open since 2017 · what a lot of people like is that it has an outdoor pool, a lift and free parking — not something you find often at this price — plus a spread of room types from light-budget rooms up to pool-view, balcony and family rooms · prices start at about THB 650/night and climb with the room type and the season · this review pulls together what real guests say, both the good and the things worth knowing before you book, especially the late-night bar noise and rooms that are starting to show their age.

body.html: Cha Am My House at a glance — who it suits — the shortest summary is this: it's a small resort for people who want to "sleep near Cha-Am Beach and get a swim" on a budget that doesn't hurt · it isn't a five-star beachfront resort with an infinity pool and a big buffet restaurant, and it isn't a high-rise where every room has a sea view · it's a small resort of around 43 rooms in the Cha-Am beach area, on the Soi Sathani Khonong side of Ruamchit Road, that earns its keep by having an outdoor pool, a lift and free parking at guest-house prices — and that's what sets it apart from the usual budget stays in the same area · real reviews line up on who it fits: budget travellers, couples on a tight budget, groups of friends, and families who want to use Cha-Am as a seaside base, especially anyone who wants the kids to swim in the pool instead of heading to the beach every time · another group who come away happy are people driving themselves who care about parking, because there's a free private lot here · put simply, if you set your expectations to match "a small resort with a pool, near the beach, at a price you can reach," this place does its job well, and that's why its review score has held at a good level the whole time · but if you expect brand-new, flawless rooms or total peace and quiet, you'll want to choose your room carefully or consider other options in Cha-Am or over on the Hua Hin side instead.

Location and getting around — this is Cha Am My House's number-one selling point, alongside the pool · the resort sits at 234/64-66 on the Soi Sathani Khonong side of Ruamchit Road, a main part of the Cha-Am beach area, and the same soi as several budget stays in Cha-Am · what makes the location appealing is that you can walk down to Cha-Am Beach in a few minutes — plenty of reviews note the beach is very close, just a short walk, so you can stroll along the shore first thing in the morning or head out for a seafood dinner by the beach without calling a car · within walking distance you'll find seafood restaurants, convenience stores, bars and bicycle rentals all over, which is part of the charm of staying in this area · for trips a bit further out, the Cha-Am View Point is about 0.4 km away, the Cha-Am Wednesday night market about 1.7 km, Cha-Am train station about 3 km, and Hua Hin Airport (HHQ) about 19–21 km · anyone driving themselves has an edge here, because the resort has two free private parking areas, and some reviews even mention covered parking · one thing to know: this stretch of the Cha-Am beach area is a "town beach" with shops, bars and crowds on weekends, not a quiet private beach · if you like the buzz of a beach district, this location fits; but if you're after quiet, set your expectations and choose a room on the inner side first.

"Great location, the beach is a short walk away, the pool is genuinely nice and usable, the room was clean, the staff were lovely and helpful, and there's parking too — for this price in the Cha-Am beach area it's really good value."

Room types and decor — Cha Am My House has rooms at several levels to suit your budget and group size, which is a plus here because it covers everything from the tightest budget up to families · the most budget-friendly is the Budget Double Room (no window), around 14 sqm, good for people who only come to sleep and then spend the day out, and who don't mind about the view or natural light · a step up is the Standard Double Room, around 16 sqm, with a window for better light and airflow, plus a Standard Pool View option for people who want to wake up to the pool · the level many people pick is the Superior group, which comes in several styles: Superior with balcony, around 18–22 sqm, Superior Pool View, and Superior Pool Access, around 20 sqm, where you step straight down to the pool from your room — a room type that gets praise for convenience and atmosphere · for groups, there's the Triple Room (around 20–23 sqm) and the larger Family Room for families or groups of friends · all rooms are air-conditioned with a fridge, a minibar, a private bathroom and free Wi-Fi · the decor is simple and clean, not luxurious but genuinely usable · many reviews agree on the same points: the rooms are clean, some are bigger than expected, the balconies are large and the bathrooms are roomy · the things that come up are that some rooms are starting to show their age, certain fittings like the shower or TV are older models, and the cheapest room has no window, which feels cramped for anyone sensitive to enclosed spaces · if natural light, a balcony or a pool view matters to you, skip the Budget room and pick a Standard or Superior right at booking, so the experience matches what you expect.

Facilities and the pool — this is where Cha Am My House most clearly sets itself apart from the usual budget guest houses in the same area · the star is the outdoor pool with sun loungers at the side, which many reviews praise as genuinely usable and nicer than expected for a resort at this price — kids can swim, adults can chill by the water, and several families say it made the trip more fun without having to go to the beach every time · besides the pool, there's a lift — rare in budget stays — which makes hauling luggage up to the higher floors much easier, two free private parking areas for people who drive, a 24-hour reception that helps a lot for late arrivals, a rooftop terrace and a small library for relaxing · there are extra services like bicycle rental (for a fee), good for an evening ride along the Cha-Am shore, laundry, free luggage storage, and airport transfer and taxi booking (for an extra fee) · Wi-Fi is free in the common areas and rooms, though at times in certain spots the signal can be a little unstable, as you'd expect at a small place · in short, the facilities here are "above the price" in that you get a pool, a lift and parking, but it's still a small resort, not a big one with a full gym and spa.

Food and the bar — one thing Cha Am My House does better than many small places is that it has its own restaurant and bar, with breakfast included in the room rate · breakfast is served late morning, from around 8:00 AM to noon, with several options — continental, American, a full English/Irish, Asian dishes and local food · many families praise the breakfast for having plenty of choices, which is handy if you don't want to go far for food in the morning · to be straight with you, a few reviews say the breakfast portions are on the small side for some people, so big eaters may want to plan a top-up outside · there's also a bar and common areas for a light evening drink · for other meals, the resort's location helps a lot, because it's surrounded by the Cha-Am beach area full of seafood and made-to-order spots at friendly prices, just a few minutes' walk away · so many people have breakfast at the resort some days and head out to try the beachside spots for other meals · overall, food here isn't something you come for as a main draw, but it's a convenient add-on that makes the trip easier.

Service — service is another point that gets fairly consistent praise in real reviews, with the service category on Trip.com sitting at around 8.7, which is high for a place at this level · many people say the staff are friendly and helpful, with phrases like "exceptional service" and "staff were lovely and helpful" showing up in foreign reviews, whether on restaurant tips, places to go or getting around · some staff speak several languages — Thai, English and French — which makes things easier for foreign travellers · having a 24-hour reception makes life easier for people arriving late or leaving before dawn, and the luggage storage, bicycle rental and airport transfer are things many guests use and are happy with · to be straight, a few reviews mention rooms not matching the booking at times — for example getting a corner room narrower than the photos — which is fixable by telling the front desk and asking to move at check-in · overall the service here is good, and it's one of the reasons people come back.

What real reviews say (the praise and the gripes) — gathered from Trip.com, Booking.com, Agoda and Tripadvisor, and the picture is fairly consistent · On the praise side: a location close to the beach you can walk to, a pool that's nice and genuinely usable, clean rooms — some bigger than expected, good cold air-conditioning, friendly staff and good service, a lift and free parking, an in-house restaurant and bar, breakfast with several options, and value for money given the location and facilities · On the watch-out side: what comes up is rooms starting to show their age — the resort has been open since 2017, and some rooms and fittings like the shower or TV are older models, with a few reviews saying it feels "kind of old" · next is noise — the Cha-Am beach area has bars nearby, and some reviews say the resort is "surrounded by the bar," so poorly soundproofed rooms may pick up outside noise at night · there's also the matter of not getting the room you booked — such as a narrow corner room, the no-window Budget room feeling cramped, and the breakfast portions some find small · most of these gripes are things you can manage by choosing the right room and setting your expectations, rather than big problems that keep people from coming back.

"The pool is better than the price suggests, the kids loved it, you can walk to the beach and the staff are lovely · the one gripe is the rooms look a bit dated and the shower is an older model, but at this price with both a pool and a lift it's still very okay."

Price comparison and value — the starting price for Budget/Standard rooms is around THB 650/night at regular rates, climbing to roughly THB 1,200–1,800+ for Superior pool-view, balcony, Pool Access or family rooms in high season or over long holidays · compared with other stays in the Cha-Am beach area, Cha Am My House feels like standout value among affordable stays near the beach, because you get what most budget stays don't: a pool, a lift and free parking · against a guest house on the same soi like The Beach Cha Am Guest House at a similar price, Cha Am My House has the edge with its pool and lift; against beachfront high-rises with sea-view rooms like Asia Cha-am or Golden Beach, it's clearly cheaper, but you trade that for not being right on the beach and not having sea-view rooms · for people coming to Cha-Am to stroll the shore, swim in the pool, cycle and eat seafood, using the place as a base to relax, the money you spend on a resort with a pool at this price comes back as good value.

What to know before you book — a few things help the stay go smoothly · one, if you're a light sleeper or sensitive to noise, ask for a room on the inner side or a floor far from the bar district right at booking, because the Cha-Am beach area has bars and late-night buzz, and some rooms aren't well soundproofed · two, don't book on the lowest price alone — the cheapest Budget room has no window, so if you want natural light, a balcony or a pool view, pick a Standard or Superior · three, if you want to step down to the pool from your room, choose Superior Pool Access specifically and state it clearly when booking · four, check the photos and room details carefully, because a few reviews got a room that didn't match the booking; if you do, tell the front desk and ask to move at check-in · five, there's a deposit of around THB 500 at check-in, refunded on check-out day, so have cash or a card ready · six, if you bring a pet, they're allowed, but there's an extra charge per night and you should ask about the conditions in advance · seven, over long holidays and in high season the Cha-Am beach area fills up fast and prices climb, so book ahead and compare prices across platforms.

The bottom line — from everything real reviews say, Cha Am My House is the best fit for people who want to sleep near Cha-Am Beach on a reachable budget but still want a pool to dip into and a lift for convenience · its strengths are a genuinely usable outdoor pool, a lift, free private parking, a spread of room types to suit your budget, an in-house restaurant and bar, breakfast included with several options, friendly staff with good service, and a location in the Cha-Am beach area where it's easy to walk to the beach and find food · the trade-off is that it's a small resort open since 2017, with some rooms and fittings starting to show their age, a no-window cheapest room, some rooms that aren't well soundproofed near the bar district, and no sea-view rooms since it isn't right on the beach · if you're after a beachfront resort with sea-view rooms and luxury, this may not be the answer, and you should look at beachfront high-rises or bigger resorts in Cha-Am or over on the Hua Hin side · but for a light seaside trip where you want a pool, a location near the beach and parking at a good price, with the right room chosen to match what you want — Cha Am My House is an option that does its job well, and that's why its review score has held at 8.5 the whole time.

faq.q: Where is Cha Am My House · can you walk to the beach?
faq.a: It's at 234/64-66 Soi Sathani Khonong (Ruamchit Road), in the Cha-Am beach area, Cha-Am District, Phetchaburi · you can walk down to Cha-Am Beach in a few minutes · nearby are seafood restaurants, convenience stores, bars and bicycle rentals · the Cha-Am View Point is about 0.4 km away, the Wednesday night market about 1.7 km, Cha-Am train station about 3 km, and Hua Hin Airport about 19–21 km.

faq.q: What does Cha Am My House start at · what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start at about THB 650/night for a Budget Double (no window, ~14 sqm) · there's a Standard Double (with window/pool view, ~16 sqm), Superior with a balcony or pool view (~18–22 sqm), Superior Pool Access (~20 sqm), a Triple Room and a Family Room (up to about 30 sqm) · prices depend on the season and room type, climbing fast over long holidays, so always compare across platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Cha Am My House have a pool?
faq.a: Yes — an outdoor pool with sun loungers, which is the highlight here · many reviews praise it as nice and genuinely usable for a resort at this price; kids can swim and adults can chill by the water · there's a Superior Pool Access room type that steps straight down to the pool from your room, plus pool-view rooms to choose from.

faq.q: Who does Cha Am My House suit best?
faq.a: It's a great fit for budget travellers, couples, groups of friends and families who want to sleep near Cha-Am Beach on a light budget but still want a pool to dip into · it suits people doing Cha-Am by strolling the shore, swimming in the pool, cycling and eating seafood, more than those looking for a luxury beachfront resort with sea-view rooms.

faq.q: What review score does Cha Am My House get?
faq.a: It scores around 8.5 out of 10 from 181 reviews on Trip.com, with location around 8.8, service around 8.7 and cleanliness around 8.6 · what people consistently praise is the location near the beach, the pool, cleanliness, friendly staff and the value · most gripes are about rooms starting to show their age, late-night bar noise and the no-window Budget room.

faq.q: Does Cha Am My House have a lift, parking and breakfast?
faq.a: It has all three · this place has a lift, rare in budget stays and handy for hauling luggage upstairs, two free private parking areas, and breakfast included with several options — continental, American, English and local food, served from 8:00 AM to noon · it also has an in-house restaurant and bar, a 24-hour reception, free Wi-Fi and bicycle rental (for an extra fee).
